UI_trait_HikiTraits_SelectiveEaterDesc: Eating processed food without preparing it increases Unhappiness. Cold or raw food or eating directly from the pot also increases a bit of unhapiness each.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_AnimalLoverDesc: Going a full day without interacting with an animal begins to increase Unhappiness. Pet it to interact.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_ExerciseRoutineDesc: Going a full day without exercising increases Unhappiness. An exercise series is enough to maintain the routine.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_RoadTripperDesc: Driving a moving vehicle slowly reduces Stress and Unhappiness.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_PanicFumblingDesc: Exertion while panicked may loosen bandages or reopen stitches. The chance increases with Panic.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_ThrillSeekerDesc: Going more than two days without reaching at least 50% Stress or Panic causes severe Boredom.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_LoudWhenHurtDesc: Tends to cry out whenever a new injury is suffered, even a minor one.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_TaskFixationDesc: Cancelling an action before it is completed may cause Stress.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_ExhaustionAnxietyDes: Low endurance causes Stress. Severe exhaustion also causes Panic.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_WeightAnxietyDesc: While above or below the normal weight range, suffers recurring Stress.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_MeditateDesc: While sitting, panic and stress are gradually reduced.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_HighSpiritsDesc: Recovers Endurance faster if not unhappy in the slightest. (Unhappiness 0)
UI_trait_HikiTraits_ShrugItOffDesc: When reaching maximum pain, current pain is reduced in half. This effect can only occur again after the pain reaches 0.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_ComfortEaterDesc: Recovers a bit of stress after eating.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_BittenNoDesc: The first time you get bitten, the injury gets turned in a laceration, also saving you from the Knox Infection.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_NeckReflexDesc: While not out of breath or exhausted, neck injuries are turned into scratches. Loses a lot of endurance when activated. (-50% Endurance)
UI_trait_HikiTraits_MeatFueledDesc: Eating fresh meat not prepared in a meal recovers a lot of Endurance. (+15% Endurance)
UI_trait_HikiTraits_SlipperyWhenWetDesc: When wet, you avoid some attacks. Lvl of the moodle defines what. At least 1 = Scratches. At least 2-3 = +Lacerations. 4 = +Bites. You can still be dragged down.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_NeverJustAScratchDes: When you would receive a scratch, you get a laceration instead.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_JustAScratchDesc: When you would receive a laceration, you get a scratch instead.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_BalancedDietDesc: High Protein grants +2 Carrying Capacity. High Carbohydrates gradually restore additional Endurance.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_RegenerativeMetaboli: Slowly converts Calories and body weight into Health while injured. Stops working when Calories or weight become too low.
UI_trait_HikiTraits_ImmunocompromisedDes: After two days without taking Antibiotics, Sickness begins accumulating at an increasingly rapid rate. Taking Antibiotics resets the timer.
